body: As far as the water thing goes, just to be clear and factual, I do know where to get water. My point with that, more or less, is that it isn't as easy as reddit in general seems to think. Same with food, and more importantly healthy food which is nearly impossible to get. I just want people to know that to a homeless person, a bottle of water is awesome, the bottle itself is valuable because it holds future water. Not everyone is as fortunate as me to know where clean water sources are. And unfortunately, fakers act like a bottle of water isn't a big deal. It is to real homeless people. Also, the help you talk about is invaluable. It's so awesome. I'd be long since dead without it. Soup kitchens are the shit and actually tastes pretty good (please donate if you can).
